name: luxurious_roman
description: Luxurious Roman is a semi-hand lettered font with inconsistent serifs and a subtle bouncy look to create that 'imperfect' hand calligraphed feel. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/luxurious-roman .
